USD swingline pricing differs: the TS says Base Rate + Base Rate margin, the CA uses one-month Term SOFR (reset daily) + the SOFR margin. The Base Rate is at least Term SOFR + 1.00%, and the Base Rate margin is exactly 1.00% below the SOFR margin at every level. So the CA rate is never higher, and it is lower by roughly (prime - Term SOFR - 1.00%), typically about 2%, whenever prime sets the Base Rate. This favours the borrower.

The operative terms are in the conformed copy attached as Exhibit A, which starts at PDF p.28. The conformed copy's own page numbers in its table of contents do not match PDF page numbers, and all CA page references here are PDF pages. The reconciliation is against the agreement as amended. The Amendment body (pp.1-27) contains only conditions, representations and boilerplate, and does not override any group-A economics in Exhibit A. Facility totals were taken from the Amendment recitals and the Euro Term Facility definition. (3) The text extraction drops the euro symbol, so "214,500,000" in the Euro Term Facility definition is a euro amount. (4) The pricing grids are garbled in the -layout text of both documents. They were re-extracted with pdftotext -raw (TS PDF p.29; CA PDF p.40) and confirmed tier by tier in this review. (5) The CA keys maturity to the fixed date April 10, 2031. The Amendment No. 4 Effective Date is defined as the date the conditions were satisfied and is not separately stated; it is assumed to be April 10, 2026. (6) The conformed-copy extraction has some sub-clause labelling glitches, e.g. Section 2.01(b) and (c) appear as "(a)" and "(b)". Section references below use the correct lettering. (7) There is a minor internal CA inconsistency: the Amendment No. 4 recital dates Amendment No. 1 as March 17, 2020, while the conformed-copy definition says May 17, 2020. This does not affect the TS reconciliation. (8) All 19 original ts_quote/ca_quote strings were checked mechanically, with whitespace collapsed, and are verbatim. The A11 ca_quote was replaced only because the garbled grid fragment was misleading. Rows X01 (expenses) and X02 (cost and yield protection) were added for economic Addendum I items the first pass had not reconciled.

TS: "Summary of Principal Terms and Conditions" for Quaker Chemical Corporation, "$[1.55][1.6] BILLION SENIOR SECURED CREDIT FACILITIES", marked "Posting Version 3/25/26". It runs 27 pages plus Addendum I (pricing, fees and expenses) at PDF pp.28-29. It is a formal pre-syndication term sheet, still showing bracketed facility amounts and pricing, and is framed as an amendment (or amendment and restatement) of the August 1, 2019 Existing Credit Agreement.

CA: Amendment No. 4 to Credit Agreement dated April 10, 2026, filed as Exhibit 10.1 (PDF pp.1-27, including the conditions precedent, reaffirmation and signature pages). Its Exhibit A is a conformed copy of the Credit Agreement dated August 1, 2019, as amended by Amendments No. 1 (Mar 17, 2020), No. 2 (Dec 10, 2021), No. 3 (Jun 17, 2022) and No. 4 (PDF pp.28-213). Reconciliation was performed against the agreement as amended (Exhibit A) together with the Amendment's own conditions and reaffirmations.

Limitations:
- The extracted CA text ends at Section 10.23 (PDF p.213). Exhibit B (schedules, including Schedule 2.01 commitments) and Exhibit C (exhibits, e.g. the Guaranty (Exhibit F), the Security and Pledge Agreement forms and Appendix A Dutch Auction procedures) are not in the text. Guarantee and collateral terms were therefore reconciled only as reflected in the Credit Agreement itself.
- The pre-amendment Existing Credit Agreement was not provided. TS items expressly tied to it (event-of-default grace periods and materiality thresholds, bail-in) were checked only against the amended text.
- PDF page rendering was unavailable (pdftoppm not installed). No Group B item depended on a garbled table.
- Group A economics (amounts, pricing, maturities, accordion/incremental, prepayments) were excluded per instructions. Swingline mechanics (minimum amounts, 10-business-day repayment) were treated as Group A sublimit terms.

CA drafting observations:
- In the extracted text, Section 7.11 labels two clauses "(a)", and its proviso refers to an undefined "Consolidated Senior Net Leverage Ratio".
- Some sub-clause letters in Sections 5.05, 9.01, 10.04 and 10.06 are mis-sequenced in the text, so the cross-reference lettering was used. In s.5.05, the audited and unaudited financial statement reps are both lettered "(a)". As a result, the s.4.02(a) deeming rule for "Sections 5.05(a) and (b)" reaches only the financial-statement reps, and the no-MAE rep (lettered "(b)") is brought down at each Credit Extension.
- The repeating no-MAE representation in Section 5.05 refers to December 31, 2021, although the Audited Financial Statements run to December 31, 2025 and the Amendment No. 4 closing MAE condition uses December 31, 2025.
